items.title: 川普：黃仁勳稱不知道她是間諜！FBI介入調查 輝達董事會啟動獨立調查
items.title_en: Trump: Jensen Huang Says He Didn’t Know She Was a Spy! FBI Investigates, NVIDIA Board Launches Independent Probe
paras: 美國總統川普周一(9日)表示，他已親自詢問輝達 (NVIDIA) (NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳，是否知道與他有密切關係的中國籍女性涉及間諜活動，黃仁勳回答「完全不知道她是間諜」。川普表示相信黃仁勳，並透露聯邦調查局(FBI)正在調查此事，認為黃仁勳最終應能安然度過風波。
川普在白宮簡報會上表示，他對相關指控感到驚訝，並稱自己已向黃仁勳直接詢問：「你知道她是間諜嗎？」黃仁勳回答「我完全不知道她是間諜」。川普表示：「我真的相信他」，並認為黃仁勳不必過度擔心FBI調查，預期他會沒事。
這番談話與川普前一天的說法有所不同。川普周日(8日)曾表示尚未與黃仁勳討論相關指控，並稱黃仁勳是「值得尊敬的人」，但周一則證實兩人已通話，黃仁勳也向他說明自己對該女子涉嫌間諜活動並不知情。
事件源自《紐約時報》10月的報導。報導引述美國情報官員說法指出，黃仁勳與一名中國籍商界女性Alice Huang關係密切，美方情報機構懷疑她曾替北京蒐集資訊。她曾任新加坡資料中心業者Megaspeed International高階主管，與黃仁勳同姓但沒有親屬關係。
黃仁勳周日已向輝達員工承認對妻子不忠，並為自己的婚外情公開道歉。他表示，自己的行為傷害妻子與子女，沒有任何藉口，並承諾對家人、員工及公司承擔責任。黃仁勳在聲明中並未點名該名女性，但表示將全力配合調查，致力保護輝達及美國國家安全。
輝達董事會周日宣布啟動獨立調查，將由獨立董事組成委員會，並聘請外部獨立法律顧問協助，釐清黃仁勳是否曾成為外國情報機構的目標，以及相關接觸是否涉及公司機密或國家安全問題。
輝達表示，目前董事會沒有理由相信美國國家安全或公司機密已遭到洩露，但仍將檢視所有可取得的資訊。董事會對黃仁勳及管理團隊仍有信心，黃仁勳也承諾全力配合調查，並繼續領導公司。
爭議焦點不僅在黃仁勳的私人關係，也牽涉Megaspeed與輝達的商業往來。美國官員曾調查Megaspeed，懷疑該公司可能協助中國取得受出口管制限制的先進AI晶片。美國自2022年起逐步收緊對中國出口先進晶片及相關製造設備的限制，使這起事件進一步涉及美中科技競爭與敏感技術流向。
《美聯社》報導指出，Megaspeed曾宣稱與輝達具有合作關係，其業務包括提供AI運算能力。美國官員關注的關鍵問題，是黃仁勳是否知悉相關情報活動，以及是否有機密或具戰略價值的資訊遭到轉交。這些疑慮仍有待調查證據釐清，不能僅憑私人關係認定公司機密已外洩。
中國外交部周一否認北京企圖透過該名女性接近黃仁勳，稱所謂「中國間諜」指控毫無根據，是抹黑中國的言論。新加坡政府此前也曾駁斥《華爾街日報》相關報導，表示新加坡政府及官員並未因Alice Huang與黃仁勳的關係或其涉嫌為中國情報來源而展開調查，也沒有對她進行相關調查。
美國國會方面，部分共和黨眾議員已於11月4日致函黃仁勳，要求他本月向國會說明相關報導，認為事件涉及中國取得美國敏感科技與資訊的重大國安疑慮。民主黨參議員Chris Coons也表示，將推動調查黃仁勳及輝達是否造成國家安全風險，並要求釐清科技企業領袖與川普政府之間的關係，以及相關政策決策過程。
這起風波也使川普與黃仁勳的密切關係受到更多檢視。兩人的互動至少可追溯至2025年，黃仁勳過去兩年多次公開支持川普政府政策，也頻繁前往華府遊說，希望美國放寬部分AI晶片對中國出口限制。
《路透社》指出，黃仁勳曾於2025年5月搭乘空軍一號陪同川普訪問中國，這是美國總統近10年來首次訪中；同年9月，他也出席中國國家主席習近平訪美期間在白宮舉行的國宴。媒體另報導，輝達承諾捐助2500萬美元，支持川普規劃中的白宮宴會廳工程。
川普政府過去也曾對輝達對中銷售政策作出調整。2025年4月，黃仁勳出席川普位於佛州海湖莊園的晚宴後，政府撤回部分限制輝達AI晶片出口中國的計畫；同年12月，川普宣布允許輝達向中國出口次高階AI晶片H200，並對相關銷售收取25%的費用。
此外，川普今年10月授予黃仁勳美國最高科學成就榮譽的同一天，也披露自己夏季曾買進最高160萬美元、賣出最高100萬美元的輝達股票。白宮當時表示，川普的投資組合由第三方金融機構獨立管理。
市場方面，輝達股價周一盤中一度跌至7個月低點，開盤前跌幅約5%，公司市值約4.5兆美元。此前在AI投資可持續性疑慮及科技股整體修正下，輝達股價今年以來累積漲幅已全數回吐，黃仁勳遭調查的消息又為股價增添新的不確定性。
Yorkville Ives & Co.合夥人Dan Ives指出，若董事會調查結果導致黃仁勳離任，將對輝達股價及公司全球策略造成重大風險。他認為，黃仁勳是輝達成長故事與營運策略的核心人物，事件也可能引發更多國會調查，並使公司對中國銷售晶片面臨更嚴格檢視。
eToro首席分析師Josh Gilbert則表示，黃仁勳參與了輝達崛起的各個關鍵環節，因此任何有關其領導地位的疑慮都會影響股東信心。不過，若調查最終沒有導致高層更替，事件對公司長期基本面的影響可能有限。
整體而言，這起事件已從企業領導人的私人關係，擴大為涉及外國情報活動、AI晶片出口管制及美中科技競爭的國安議題。輝達目前強調尚無證據顯示機密外洩，川普也公開表示相信黃仁勳，但董事會調查、FBI調查及國會後續問詢結果，將決定事件是否進一步衝擊黃仁勳的領導地位，以及輝達對中國市場的業務布局。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Monday (the 9th) that he personally asked NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang whether he knew a Chinese woman with close ties to him was involved in espionage, and Huang replied, "I had no idea she was a spy." Trump said he trusts Huang and disclosed that the FBI is investigating the matter, believing Huang will ultimately get through the storm unharmed.

At a White House briefing, Trump said he was surprised by the allegations and said he asked Huang directly, "Do you know she is a spy?" Huang answered, "I had no idea she was a spy." Trump added, "I really believe him," and said Huang need not worry excessively about the FBI probe, expecting he will be fine.

This conversation differs from Trump’s remarks the day before. On Sunday (the 8th) Trump said he had not yet discussed the allegations with Huang and called him "a respectable person," but on Monday he confirmed the two had spoken and Huang told him he was unaware of the woman’s alleged espionage activities.

The episode stems from a New York Times report in October that cited U.S. intelligence officials saying Huang had a close relationship with a Chinese businesswoman named Alice Huang, whom U.S. agencies suspect of gathering information for Beijing. She previously served as a senior executive at Singapore data‑center firm Megaspeed International; despite sharing a surname, she is not related to Jensen Huang.

On Sunday, Jensen Huang admitted to NVIDIA employees that he had been unfaithful to his wife and publicly apologized for his extramarital affair. He said his actions hurt his wife and children, offered no excuses, and pledged responsibility to his family, employees, and the company. While he did not name the woman, he said he would fully cooperate with investigations and work to protect NVIDIA and U.S. national security.

NVIDIA’s board announced on Sunday that it is launching an independent investigation, forming a committee of independent directors and hiring external legal counsel to determine whether Huang has been targeted by foreign intelligence and whether any contacts involved company secrets or national‑security issues.

NVIDIA said the board currently sees no reason to believe U.S. national security or corporate confidential information has been compromised, but it will review all available data. The board remains confident in Huang and the management team; Huang has pledged full cooperation and will continue to lead the company.

The controversy centers not only on Huang’s personal relationship but also on Megaspeed’s business dealings with NVIDIA. U.S. officials have investigated Megaspeed over suspicions that the firm may have helped China obtain advanced AI chips subject to export controls. Since 2022 the United States has gradually tightened restrictions on exporting advanced chips and related equipment to China, tying the case to the broader U.S.–China tech competition and sensitive technology flows.

According to the Associated Press, Megaspeed claimed to have a partnership with NVIDIA, offering AI computing capacity. U.S. officials are focused on whether Huang was aware of any intelligence activities and whether confidential or strategically valuable information was passed on. These concerns remain unresolved pending evidence and cannot be concluded solely on the basis of a personal relationship.

China’s foreign ministry on Monday denied that Beijing was trying to use the woman to approach Huang, calling the alleged "Chinese spy" claim baseless and a smear against China. Singapore’s government previously rebuffed a Wall Street Journal report, stating that neither the Singapore government nor its officials have launched any investigation into Alice Huang’s relationship with Huang or any alleged role as a Chinese intelligence source.

In Washington, some Republican members of Congress sent a letter to Huang on November 4 requesting that he explain the reports to Congress this month, arguing the matter raises serious national‑security concerns about China acquiring U.S. sensitive technology and information. Democratic Senator Chris Coons also said he will push for an inquiry into whether Huang and NVIDIA pose a national‑security risk and called for clarification of the ties between tech‑industry leaders and the Trump administration and the related policy‑making process.

The episode has put the close relationship between Trump and Huang under greater scrutiny. Their interactions date back at least to 2025, when Huang repeatedly voiced public support for Trump‑administration policies and frequently lobbied in Washington for relaxed AI‑chip export restrictions to China.

Reuters reported that Huang flew on Air Force One with Trump on a May 2025 visit to China, the first presidential trip to China in a decade, and that in September he attended a state dinner at the White House during Chinese President Xi Jinping’s visit. Media also reported that NVIDIA pledged $25 million to support a White House banquet hall project planned by Trump.

The Trump administration previously adjusted NVIDIA’s sales policy to China. In April 2025, after Huang attended a dinner at Trump’s Mar‑a‑Lago estate, the government rolled back parts of a plan to restrict NVIDIA’s AI‑chip exports to China; in December the same year, Trump announced permission for NVIDIA to ship its second‑tier AI chip, the H200, to China, imposing a 25% fee on related sales.

In addition, on the same day Trump awarded Huang the nation’s highest scientific honor in October, he disclosed that he had bought up to $1.6 million and sold up to $1 million of NVIDIA stock during the summer. The White House said Trump’s portfolio was managed independently by a third‑party financial firm.

On the market side, NVIDIA’s share price fell to a seven‑month low on Monday, dropping about 5% before the open and leaving the company with a market value of roughly $4.5 trillion. After earlier AI‑investment sustainability concerns and a broader tech‑stock correction, the stock’s year‑to‑date gains have been fully erased, and the investigation into Huang adds fresh uncertainty.

Yorkville Ives & Co. partner Dan Ives warned that if the board’s investigation leads to Huang’s departure, it would pose a major risk to NVIDIA’s share price and global strategy. He said Huang is central to NVIDIA’s growth story and operating strategy, and the episode could trigger further congressional probes and tighter scrutiny of the company’s chip sales to China.

eToro chief analyst Josh Gilbert noted that Huang has been involved in every key phase of NVIDIA’s rise, so any doubts about his leadership will affect shareholder confidence. However, if the probe ultimately does not result in a top‑executive change, the long‑term fundamental impact on the company may be limited.

Overall, the incident has grown from a private‑relationship issue involving a corporate leader into a national‑security matter encompassing foreign‑intelligence activity, AI‑chip export controls and U.S.–China tech rivalry. NVIDIA stresses there is no evidence of a leak, Trump publicly says he trusts Huang, and the outcomes of the board’s inquiry, the FBI investigation and congressional follow‑ups will determine whether the episode further threatens Huang’s leadership and NVIDIA’s business plans in China.

items.title: 輝達逆勢跌逾4% 成費半唯一殞落股 黃仁勳去留引爆華爾街論戰
items.title_en: Nvidia Falls Over 4% Against the Trend, the Only Decline in the S&P 500 Information Technology Index; Jensen Huang's Future Sparks Wall Street Debate
paras: 費半成分股中，輝達是唯一收跌的個股，週一 (9日) 下跌 4.27%，報 178.67 美元。輝達董事會宣布啟動獨立調查，釐清黃仁勳是否曾遭外國情報行動鎖定。董事會表示，目前沒有理由認為美國國安或公司機密已受損。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 董事會調查執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 是否曾遭外國情報行動鎖定，華爾街對他的去留出現分歧。有基金經理人認為，輝達內部缺乏明確接班人，可能促使部分機構投資人減碼。也有分析師研判，除非調查導致高層更替，否則短期衝擊主要反映在市場情緒。隨著 11 月 17 日財報公布在即，投資人也在觀察調查是否會拖慢輝達的投資決策，以及對中晶片出口會否面臨更嚴格的審查。
董事會是在媒體報導黃仁勳與一名中國女商人黃樂關係密切後啟動調查。美國情報機構認為，黃樂是中國國家安全部情報人員，曾向北京傳遞資訊。
輝達董事會正在釐清黃仁勳是否曾成為外國情報行動的目標，相關指控仍有待查證。
接班人選未明 華爾街對黃仁勳去留看法分歧
The Future Fund 基金經理人 Gary Black 質疑黃仁勳能否留任。他認為，董事會勢必檢視黃仁勳的行為與判斷力，而輝達內部缺乏一名公認的接班人，可能使部分投資組合經理人在未來幾週先行減碼，短期壓抑股價。
Pepperstone 研究主管 Chris Weston 則認為黃仁勳被撤換的機率低。
他指出，黃仁勳在這一波 AI 投資浪潮中扮演核心角色，若市場真認為他即將下台，輝達股價的反應會更劇烈。
紅杉資本合夥人 Shaun Maguire 雖批評黃仁勳的判斷，仍認為他對維持美國的 AI 領先地位難以取代。
特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 執行長馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 也留言表示同意。
PIMCO 前執行長 Mohamed El-Erian 指出，輝達對科技產業、金融市場與整體經濟都具有重要影響力，但投資人一向難以衡量企業對單一領導人的依賴，也難以替公司治理風險定價。如今事件又涉及國安與地緣政治，市場評估的變數隨之增加。
韓國供應鏈盯投資時程 花旗聚焦 H200 出口合規
韓國 NH 投資證券資深分析師 Ryu Young-ho 表示，美國政府似乎已知悉此事數月，因此預期立即衝擊有限。
對韓國供應商而言，更值得關注的是調查或內部審查若拖長，輝達會否延後投資決策。若影響進一步延伸至產品出貨或新品發布，波及範圍就可能擴大至整個半導體產業。
花旗分析師 Atif Malik 則把焦點放在監管機關是否加強審查 H200 晶片流入中國的管道，包括經由第三方中介的交易是否符合出口管制規定。
他估計，H200 對中銷售占輝達資料中心業務營收不到 1%。投資人仍須關注監管審查是否擴大，以及調查對輝達公司治理與長期領導穩定性的影響。
11 月 17 日財報成下一個觀察點
輝達預定於美東時間 11 月 17 日盤後 (台灣時間 11 月 18 日清晨) 公布 2027 會計年度第三季財報。
eToro 首席分析師吉 Josh Gilbert 表示，調查風波正值 AI 類股承壓之際，短期可能打擊投資情緒。輝達財報將是輝達面臨的下一場考驗，若調查最終導致高層更替，市場才會重新評估公司的長期前景。
美國總統川普 (Donald Trump) 表示，尚未就此事與黃仁勳通話，但肯定他的人品，希望事情平安落幕。
潘興廣場資本管理公司執行長艾克曼 (Bill Ackman) 則表示，若事件涉及國安，情況就會嚴重得多。他希望風波止於私人關係，並稱若有更深層的問題，黃仁勳仍應接受檢視。
paras_en: Among the S&P 500 Information Technology constituents, Nvidia was the only stock that closed lower on Monday (the 9th), dropping 4.27% to $178.67. Nvidia’s board announced it is launching an independent investigation to determine whether CEO Jensen Huang has ever been targeted by foreign intelligence operations. The board said there is currently no reason to believe U.S. national security or company secrets have been compromised.

Nvidia (NVDA-US) board’s probe into whether CEO Jensen Huang was ever the target of foreign intelligence activity has split Wall Street on his tenure. Some fund managers argue that Nvidia lacks a clear succession plan, which could prompt certain institutional investors to reduce exposure. Other analysts contend that unless the probe triggers a top‑management change, the short‑term impact will be mainly sentiment‑driven. With the fiscal Q3 earnings slated for November 17, investors are also watching whether the investigation will slow Nvidia’s investment decisions and whether chip exports to China could face tighter scrutiny.

The board opened the investigation after media reports linked Jensen Huang to a Chinese businesswoman, Huang Le, suggesting a close relationship. U.S. intelligence agencies allege that Huang Le is an operative of China’s Ministry of State Security and has passed information to Beijing.
Nvidia’s board is seeking to determine whether Jensen Huang was ever a target of foreign intelligence activity; the allegations remain unverified.
Unclear Succession Plan Fuels Wall Street Divide on Jensen Huang’s Future

Future Fund manager Gary Black questioned whether Jensen Huang can remain in his role. He believes the board will have to scrutinize Huang’s conduct and judgment, and that Nvidia’s lack of an acknowledged successor could lead some portfolio managers to trim positions over the next few weeks, putting short‑term pressure on the stock.
Pepperstone research head Chris Weston, on the other hand, thinks the odds of Huang being removed are low.
He noted that Huang has been a core figure in the current AI investment wave, and if the market truly believed he was about to step down, Nvidia’s share price reaction would be even more pronounced.
Sequoia Capital partner Shaun Maguire, while criticizing Huang’s judgment, still sees him as irreplaceable for maintaining U.S. leadership in AI.
Tesla (TSLA‑US) CEO Elon Musk also commented in agreement.

Former PIMCO chief Mohamed El‑Erian pointed out that Nvidia has a major impact on the tech sector, financial markets and the broader economy, but investors have historically struggled to gauge a company’s reliance on a single leader and to price governance risk. With national‑security and geopolitical dimensions now in play, the variables for market assessment have increased.
Korean Supply‑Chain Timing Under Scrutiny; Citi Focuses on H200 Export Compliance
Ryu Young‑ho, senior analyst at NH Investment & Securities in Korea, said the U.S. government appears to have been aware of the matter for months, so immediate impact is expected to be limited.

For Korean suppliers, the bigger question is whether a prolonged investigation or internal review will cause Nvidia to delay its investment decisions. If the delay extends to product shipments or new product launches, the ripple effect could spread across the entire semiconductor industry.
Citi analyst Atif Malik focused on whether regulators will tighten scrutiny of H200 chips flowing to China, including whether third‑party intermediary transactions comply with export‑control rules.

He estimated that H200 sales to China represent less than 1% of Nvidia’s data‑center revenue. Investors still need to watch for broader regulatory reviews and the impact of the probe on Nvidia’s corporate governance and long‑term leadership stability.
November 17 Earnings Are the Next Watchpoint
Nvidia is scheduled to release its fiscal 2027 third‑quarter results after market close on November 17 Eastern Time (early morning November 18 Taiwan time).

eToro chief analyst Josh Gilbert said the investigation comes as AI‑related stocks are under pressure and could dampen short‑term sentiment. Nvidia’s earnings will be the next test for the company, and only if the probe leads to a top‑management change will the market reassess its long‑term outlook.
Former U.S. President Donald Trump said he has not spoken with Jensen Huang about the matter yet, but he affirms Huang’s character and hopes the issue will be resolved peacefully.

Bill Ackman, CEO of Pershing Square Capital Management, warned that if the matter involves national security the stakes become much higher. He hopes the controversy stays limited to personal relationships and said that if deeper issues emerge, Huang should still be subject to scrutiny.

paras_en: On Monday, November 9, U.S. equities closed higher across the board as a sharp decline in oil prices eased inflation worries, prompting a rebound after last week's steep drop in AI stocks. The Dow Jones Industrial Average surged 1,104 points, while both the S&P 500 and Nasdaq gained more than 2%; semiconductor stocks led the recovery, though Nvidia (NVDA-US) fell 4.2% amid concerns over an investigation involving CEO Jensen Huang.

The Dow finished at 52,390 points, up 1,104 points (2.15%); the S&P 500 closed at 7,550 points, up 173 points (2.35%); and the Nasdaq ended at 25,253 points, up 674 points (2.74%). The S&P 500 posted its largest single‑day percentage gain since April 8, while the Nasdaq recorded its biggest one‑day rise since July 30.

U.S. President Donald Trump downplayed the likelihood of another attack on Iran, sending crude oil prices sharply lower and reducing market concerns about price pressures. All ten S&P 500 sector groups rose, with nine sectors gaining more than 1%; industrials and consumer discretionary both climbed over 3%, leading the gains. After Democrats’ sweeping victory in the midterm elections last week, the market feared new regulatory headwinds for AI investments, which had caused the S&P 500 to register its biggest weekly decline since April 2025.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 6.9%, reversing more than a 12% slide from the previous week. Broadcom (AVGO-US) rose 8.8% and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD-US) surged 13.3%, providing the two main lifts for the index’s rebound. Nvidia was the only component to close lower, with its price falling to the lowest level since April 7; the company is under investigation to determine whether Jensen Huang has become a target of foreign intelligence activities, prompting investor scrutiny of his leadership prospects.

On the earnings front, KKR (KKR-US) posted record quarterly profit, sending its shares up 1.7%; Constellation Energy (CEG-US) reported third‑quarter adjusted earnings that beat expectations, lifting its stock more than 10%. Overall, the number of advancing stocks far outpaced decliners, with a ratio of about 4.06 to 1 on the NYSE and roughly 3.34 to 1 on the Nasdaq. U.S. exchange trading volume reached 18.98 billion shares, slightly above the 20‑day average of 18.72 billion.

Going forward, the market will watch U.S. October inflation data, with the Consumer Price Index (CPI) scheduled for release on Tuesday and the Producer Price Index (PPI) due on Friday. Although oil prices have retreated, a previously strong jobs report keeps attention on the Federal Reserve’s next rate moves. Richmond Federal Reserve Bank President Thomas Barkin said on Monday that the Fed should act prudently when shaping policies to address inflation.

費半成分股中，輝達是唯一收跌的個股，下跌 4.27%，報 178.67 美元。輝達董事會宣布啟動獨立調查，釐清黃仁勳是否曾遭外國情報行動鎖定。董事會表示，目前沒有理由認為美國國安或公司機密已受損。

paras_en: U.S. stocks on Monday (the 9th) closed sharply higher, as a steep drop in oil prices eased inflation concerns and tech stocks attracted bargain hunters after last week's steep decline. Boosted by gains in Goldman Sachs and Kinetic Heavy Industries, the Dow Jones Industrial Average surged more than 1,100 points, regaining the closing level seen on the U.S. midterm election voting day.

All 11 sectors of the S&P 500 closed in the green, delivering the best single‑day performance since April 8, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 6.86%. Nvidia (NVDA‑US) fell 4.27% despite the rally, after its board launched an independent investigation involving CEO Jensen Huang.

Falling oil prices also lifted market sentiment. With expectations rising that the conflict in Iran may ease, U.S. West Texas Intermediate crude futures fell 4.38% to $86.85 a barrel, and Brent crude futures dropped 5.85% to $92.57 a barrel.

Former U.S. President Donald Trump said the likelihood of ordering a large‑scale strike on Iran is very low. Regarding rumors linking Jensen Huang’s alleged extramarital affair to espionage, Trump said, “I haven’t talked to Jensen about this. I only know he’s a good person, but you never really know what’s going on.”
The U.S. will release the October Consumer Price Index (CPI) on Tuesday and the Producer Price Index (PPI) on Friday, giving the market data to gauge the Fed’s likely rate path in December.
U.S. market performance on Monday (the 9th):

The Dow Jones Industrial Average surged 1,104.02 points, or 2.15%, to 52,389.75. The Nasdaq Composite jumped 673.71 points, or 2.74%, to 25,253.14. The board said there is currently no reason to believe U.S. national security or company secrets have been compromised.
AMD (AMD‑US) surged 13.26% to $508.58 per share. Oppenheimer upgraded AMD to “outperform” with a price target of $600 and projected its 2027 data‑center revenue to grow 135%.

Boeing (BA‑US) said that because the ramp‑up of commercial aircraft production is lagging expectations, it will slow its production schedule, creating excess labor in the commercial‑aircraft division and planning to cut about 5% of its workforce. items.title: 黃仁勳婚外情 美做空機構5月已踢爆內幕
items.title_en: Jensen Huang's Affair Sparks U.S. Short Seller Report in May
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 坦承婚外情，董事會也就他是否曾遭外國情報行動鎖定展開獨立調查。這場風波讓放空機構 Culper Research 半年前發布的一份報告再受關注。報告當時就點名新加坡資料中心業者 Megaspeed，追查其資金來源、馬來西亞子公司的伺服器採購，以及黃仁勳與 Megaspeed 前主管黃樂 (Alice Huang) 的往來。
放空機構估中國需求仍占輝達運算營收逾兩成
Culper 於 5 月 13 日發布約 40 頁的報告，同時揭露持有輝達空頭部位。
該機構指出，美國於 2025 年 4 月收緊對中晶片出口限制後，黃仁勳曾表示，輝達在中國的運算晶片市占率降至零。
Culper 則推估，輝達 2026 會計年度逾 20% 的運算業務營收仍由中國需求帶動，理由是搭載輝達晶片的設備可能透過東南亞中間商流向中國。這項比例為放空機構的估算，相關轉運指控仍待證實。
Megaspeed 是報告追查的核心。
《紐約時報》此前報導，這家新加坡業者在兩年間採購逾 48 億美元的輝達晶片，成為輝達在東南亞的主要客戶之一。
Culper 則從公司申報資料追查這家業者如何在短時間內取得大筆採購資金。
29 億美元可退還款項牽出阿里巴巴關係企業
Culper 引述財報指出，Megaspeed 的負債與股東權益合計金額，從 2023 年底約 3,300 萬美元增至 2024 年底約 30 億美元，其中約 29 億美元列為收到的可退還款項，財報未揭露付款方。
另一份馬來西亞公司文件顯示，Megaspeed 子公司 Speedmatrix 曾將公司資產質押給新加坡的 Apex Enterprise Solutions，而 Apex 的最終母公司為阿里巴巴 (BABA-US)。
Culper 據此推測，阿里巴巴可能透過 Apex 為相關伺服器採購提供資金。
不過，質押文件僅顯示 Speedmatrix 與 Apex 之間存在擔保安排，尚無法確認 Megaspeed 帳上那筆 29 億美元款項的來源。
輝達曾向《紐約時報》表示，Megaspeed 由中國境外的公司持有並營運，沒有中國股東。
《金融時報》報導，輝達曾赴 Megaspeed 在新加坡的設施突擊查核，未發現晶片轉運至中國的證據。
台廠技鋼也被點名 出貨紀錄指向馬來西亞
Culper 引述貿易資料指出，Speedmatrix 自 2024 年 12 月至 2026 年 1 月進口約 46 億美元的產品，其中約 40 億美元來自輝達伺服器合作夥伴 Aivres Systems。
報告也指出，技嘉 (2376-TW) 旗下技鋼科技 (Giga Computing) 自 2024 年 12 月起出口至少 5.11 億美元的設備，其中約 3.44 億美元出貨給 Speedmatrix，另約 1.42 億美元出貨給同樣位於馬來西亞的 Novagate Cloud。
這些貿易紀錄可辨識出貨對象，最終使用者及設備是否再轉運仍待查證。
黃仁勳續任執行長 財報與國會簡報受關注
Culper 在 5 月的報告中提到，黃仁勳與黃樂曾於 2024 年 6 月在台北出席同一場聚會，並於 2025 年 5 月在台灣一同用餐。
報告當時聚焦兩人的往來與 Megaspeed 的業務關係。直到 10 月 29 日，《紐約時報》才報導，美國情報部門認定黃樂曾向北京提供資訊。中國外交部駁斥相關指控。
輝達董事會於美東時間 11 月 8 日宣布，由獨立董事組成委員會，在外部律師協助下展開調查。
董事會表示，目前沒有理由認為美國國家安全或輝達機密受到損害。黃仁勳在致員工信中坦承對妻子不忠，信中未點名對象。他承諾全力配合調查，並將在調查期間續任執行長。
輝達預定於台灣時間 11 月 18 日凌晨公布財報，上午 6 時舉行法說會。
美國眾議院三名共和黨籍委員會主席另要求黃仁勳於美東時間 11 月 18 日就相關報導及輝達的安全防護措施進行閉門簡報。
市場將關注輝達是否會加強對東南亞客戶與設備最終用途的查核，以及調查會否影響公司在美國出口管制下的業務布局。
多項利空環繞，AI巨頭輝達 (NVDA-US) 週一逆勢下跌超4%，阿里巴巴ADR (BABA-US) 同步下滑近 4%。費半指數大漲超6%。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair, and the board has launched an independent investigation into whether he was ever targeted by foreign intelligence operations. This scandal has brought renewed attention to a short‑seller report released by Culper Research six months ago. The report at the time singled out Singapore data‑center operator Megaspeed, probing its funding sources, the server purchases of its Malaysian subsidiary, and the interactions between Huang and former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang.
The short‑seller estimates that Chinese demand still accounts for more than 20% of NVIDIA's compute revenue.
Culper released a roughly 40‑page report on May 13, simultaneously disclosing its short position in NVIDIA.
The firm noted that after the United States tightened chip export restrictions to China in April 2025, Huang said NVIDIA's market share for compute chips in China had fallen to zero.

Culper projects that over 20% of NVIDIA's fiscal 2026 compute‑business revenue will still be driven by Chinese demand, reasoning that devices using NVIDIA chips could be routed to China through Southeast Asian intermediaries. This proportion is the short‑seller’s estimate, and the alleged transshipment remains unverified.
Megaspeed is the focal point of the report’s investigation.
A previous New York Times story reported that the Singapore firm purchased more than $4.8 billion worth of NVIDIA chips over two years, making it one of NVIDIA’s major customers in Southeast Asia.
Culper traced how the company obtained large purchase funds in a short period using its filing data.
$2.9 billion in refundable payments implicates an Alibaba affiliate

Culper cited financial statements showing Megaspeed’s liabilities and equity rose from about $33 million at the end of 2023 to roughly $30 billion at the end of 2024, with about $2.9 billion listed as refundable amounts received, though the payer was not disclosed.
Another Malaysian company document shows Megaspeed’s subsidiary Speedmatrix pledged assets to Singapore’s Apex Enterprise Solutions, whose ultimate parent is Alibaba (BABA-US).
Culper therefore speculates that Alibaba may have funded the related server purchases through Apex.
However, the pledge documents only reveal a guarantee arrangement between Speedmatrix and Apex, and cannot confirm the source of the $2.9 billion on Megaspeed’s books.
NVIDIA told the New York Times that Megaspeed is owned and operated by companies outside China and has no Chinese shareholders.
The Financial Times reported that NVIDIA conducted a surprise audit at Megaspeed’s Singapore facility and found no evidence of chips being shipped to China.
Taiwanese manufacturer Giga Steel also named, with shipment records pointing to Malaysia
Culper cited trade data showing Speedmatrix imported about $4.6 billion of products from December 2024 to January 2026, roughly $4 billion of which came from NVIDIA server partner Aivres Systems.

The report also noted that Giga Computing, a subsidiary of Gigabyte (2376‑TW), exported at least $511 million of equipment since December 2024, about $344 million of which went to Speedmatrix and roughly $142 million to Novagate Cloud, also based in Malaysia.
These trade records identify the shipment recipients, but whether the end‑users or equipment were subsequently re‑exported remains to be verified.
Huang’s continuation as CEO draws scrutiny to earnings releases and congressional briefings
Culper’s May report mentioned that Huang and Alice Huang attended the same event in Taipei in June 2024 and dined together in Taiwan in May 2025.

The report focused on their interactions and Megaspeed’s business ties until the New York Times reported on October 29 that U.S. intelligence agencies concluded Alice Huang had provided information to Beijing, a claim denied by China’s foreign ministry.
NVIDIA’s board announced on November 8 Eastern Time that a committee of independent directors, assisted by external counsel, would begin an investigation.

The board said there is currently no reason to believe U.S. national security or NVIDIA confidential information has been compromised. In a letter to employees, Huang admitted infidelity to his wife without naming the other party. He pledged full cooperation with the probe and will remain CEO during the investigation.
NVIDIA plans to release its earnings report in the early hours of November 18 Taiwan time, with a conference call at 6 a.m. local time.
Three Republican chairs of U.S. House committees have also requested that Huang give a closed‑door briefing on November 18 Eastern Time regarding the reports and NVIDIA’s security safeguards.

The market will watch whether NVIDIA tightens due‑diligence on Southeast Asian customers and final equipment uses, and whether the investigation affects its business layout under U.S. export controls.

Multiple headwinds surrounded the AI giant as NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) fell more than 4% on Monday despite the broader AI rally, while Alibaba ADR (BABA‑US) slipped nearly 4%. The semiconductor index surged over 6%.

items.title: 《巴隆》分析：為何黃仁勳下台 恐比婚外情更傷輝達？
items.title_en: Baron Analysis: Why Jensen Huang’s Resignation Could Hurt Nvidia More Than an Affair
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 坦承婚外情，董事會啟動獨立調查，釐清他是否曾遭外國情報行動鎖定。黃仁勳在調查期間續任。《巴隆周刊》分析，若調查未影響訂單與出貨，輝達的獲利前景未必會因此改變。但若黃仁勳下台，由於公司未公開明確接班人選，市場將面臨更難估算的風險。
黃仁勳在致員工信中坦承對妻子不忠，並承諾全力配合調查，信中未點名對象。輝達週一 (9 日) 重挫逾 4%，同期超微 (AMD-US) 與博通 (AVGO-US) 分別高漲約 13% 和 9%
他已向董事會承認與新加坡資料中心業者 Megaspeed 前高層黃樂 (Alice Huang) 有親密關係。輝達董事會表示，目前沒有理由認為美國國家安全或公司機密受損。
美國情報部門研判黃樂曾向北京提供資訊，中國外交部已駁斥相關指控。
撤換黃仁勳將使股價承受更大壓力
Melius Research 分析師 Ben Reitzes 表示，他原先預期黃仁勳至少還會再掌舵 10 年，目前看不到明確接班人。
輝達有財務長克瑞斯 (Colette Kress)、技術長卡根 (Michael Kagan) 與首席科學家戴利 (Bill Dally) 等資深主管，可維持日常營運。
不過，據《紐約時報》報導，約 60 名主管直接向黃仁勳報告。
一旦換帥，投資人將重新評估新任執行長能否延續輝達的產品路線、維繫大客戶關係，並接手對 AI 產業的投資決策。
Mahoney Asset Management 執行長 Ken Mahoney 認為，只要營運未受實質損害，消息引發的波動未必會改變輝達的獲利前景，但撤換黃仁勳將使股價承受更大壓力。
Freedom Broker 資深股票分析師 Egor Tolmachev 則估計，若黃仁勳被迫下台，且美國當局考慮對輝達採取措施，最壞情境下股價可能下跌 10% 至 30%，幅度取決於接班人選及可能的制裁力道。
留任仍有兩項營運變數　亞洲訂單與 AI 投資
短期最容易反映在業績上的變數，是亞洲客戶訂單。
花旗分析師 Atif Malik 指出，投資人須留意監管是否擴及經由中間商流向中國的晶片。
《巴隆周刊》分析，若輝達加強查核亞洲客戶及設備最終用途，導致既有訂單延後或取消，才可能對近期營運造成更直接的影響。Megaspeed 已否認涉及非法轉運。
輝達先前給出的第三季營收財測為 1,080 億美元、上下浮動 2%，已排除來自中國的資料中心運算營收。
《路透》報導，約 60 萬顆 H200 晶片仍存放在香港，等待運往中國。
知情人士指出，北京已允許少量晶片進口，但尚未批准大批進口。直接對中銷售能否恢復規模，原本就取決於美中兩方的政策。
另一項變數是輝達是否調整對外投資。
輝達過去 12 個月產生約 1,270 億美元自由現金流，其中約 44% 用於庫藏股。
輝達也投資 AI 新創和雲端業者，部分被投資企業同時是其晶片客戶。若輝達縮減這類投資，公司可能有更多資金可用於回購股票，部分業者則可能需要另覓資金擴建算力。
高盛維持 300 美元目標價　市場等財報檢驗
高盛分析師 James Schneider 維持看多立場與 300 美元目標價，認為近期股價回檔後，財報公布前的市場部位較為有利。投資人仍擔憂供電與機房空間不足，可能限制 2028 年資料中心擴建。
輝達上季資料中心營收年增 117% 至 890 億美元，整體毛利率為 75%。
公司將於台灣時間 11 月 18 日凌晨公布財報，上午 6 時舉行法說會。
屆時，新一季財測、晶片交付時程與亞洲客戶訂單，將是判斷風波是否已影響營運的依據。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair, prompting the board to launch an independent investigation to determine whether he has been targeted by foreign intelligence operations. Huang will remain in his role during the probe. Baron Weekly analysis says that if the investigation does not affect orders and shipments, Nvidia’s profit outlook may not change. However, if Huang steps down, the lack of a publicly identified successor would create a harder‑to‑price risk for the market.

In a letter to employees, Huang confessed infidelity to his wife and pledged full cooperation with the investigation, without naming the other party. Nvidia shares fell more than 4% on Monday the 9th, while AMD (AMD-US) and Broadcom (AVGO-US) rose about 13% and 9% respectively.

He has acknowledged to the board a close relationship with former Megaspeed senior executive Alice Huang, a Singapore data‑center operator. The Nvidia board said there is currently no reason to believe U.S. national security or company secrets have been compromised.
U.S. intelligence agencies assess that Alice Huang may have passed information to Beijing, a claim the Chinese foreign ministry has denied.
Removing Jensen Huang would put greater pressure on the stock price.
Melius Research analyst Ben Reitzes said he had originally expected Huang to stay at the helm for at least another ten years and now sees no clear successor.
Nvidia’s senior management includes CFO Colette Kress, CTO Michael Kagan and chief scientist Bill Dally, who can keep day‑to‑day operations running.
However, a New York Times report notes that about 60 executives report directly to Huang.
If a leadership change occurs, investors will reassess whether the new CEO can continue Nvidia’s product roadmap, maintain key customer relationships and steer AI‑industry investment decisions.

Mahoney Asset Management CEO Ken Mahoney believes that as long as operations are not materially harmed, the volatility from the news may not alter Nvidia’s profit outlook, but removing Huang would increase pressure on the share price.

Freedom Broker senior analyst Egor Tolmachev estimates that if Huang is forced out and U.S. authorities consider actions against Nvidia, the worst‑case scenario could see the stock drop 10% to 30%, depending on the successor and any sanctions.
Two operational variables remain if he stays: Asian orders and AI investment.
The short‑term factor most likely to affect earnings is orders from Asian customers.
Citigroup analyst Atif Malik warned investors to watch whether regulations expand to chips routed through intermediaries to China.

Baron Weekly analysis says that if Nvidia tightens scrutiny of Asian customers and end‑use of equipment, causing existing orders to be delayed or cancelled, that could directly impact near‑term operations. Megaspeed has denied any illegal re‑export.
Nvidia previously forecast Q3 revenue of $108 billion, plus or minus 2%, excluding data‑center revenue from China.
Reuters reported that about 600,000 H200 chips are still stored in Hong Kong awaiting shipment to China.
Sources said Beijing has allowed a small amount of chip imports but has not approved large‑scale shipments. Whether direct sales to China can resume at scale depends on policies from both sides.
Another variable is whether Nvidia will adjust its external investments.
In the past 12 months Nvidia generated roughly $127 billion of free cash flow, about 44% of which was used for share buybacks.

Nvidia also invests in AI startups and cloud providers, many of which are also its chip customers. If Nvidia cuts such investments, more cash could be used for buybacks, while those companies might need to find other funding to expand compute capacity.
Goldman Sachs maintains a $300 price target and awaits earnings verification.

Goldman analyst James Schneider kept a bullish stance with a $300 target, saying that after the recent pullback the market position ahead of the earnings release is relatively favorable. Investors remain concerned about power supply and data‑center space constraints that could limit data‑center expansion through 2028.
Nvidia’s data‑center revenue grew 117% year‑over‑year to $89 billion last quarter, with an overall gross margin of 75%.
The company will release its earnings in the early hours of November 18 Taiwan time, with a webcast at 6 a.m. local time.
At that time, the new quarter outlook, chip delivery schedule and Asian customer orders will be the key gauges of whether the scandal has impacted operations.

items.title: 特斯拉恐遭踢出科技七巨頭？SpaceX有望取代、兩家公司合併估值上看4兆美元
items.title_en: Tesla May Be Ousted from the Magnificent Seven? SpaceX Poised to Replace It, Combined Valuation Could Reach $4 Trillion
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US) 在美股「科技七巨頭」（Magnificent Seven）的地位可能不保。美國財經媒體《巴隆周刊》分析指出，特斯拉無論在現金流、獲利能力或估值方面，都與其他六家科技巨頭存在明顯差距，反而是馬斯克旗下太空探索公司SpaceX(SPCX-US) 更符合這個投資組合的定位。
根據報導，「科技七巨頭」一詞由美銀策略師Michael Hartnett於2023年提出，借用經典西部電影《絕地7騎士》（The Magnificent Seven）的概念，形容七家有能力在市場動盪中為投資人提供保障的企業。
不過，特斯拉從一開始就與其他成員有所不同。儘管公司已建立規模可觀的電動車及能源儲存業務，但現金流創造能力始終難以與其他成員相比。
特斯拉2022年自由現金流創下約80億美元的歷史新高，但Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 同年創造的自由現金流達600億美元，蘋果(AAPL-US) 更超過1,000億美元。
估值也是一大問題。特斯拉目前股價相當於未來12個月預估獲利的約180倍，科技七巨頭其他成員的平均本益比則約為22倍。
獲利率方面，特斯拉第三季營業利益率僅2.6%，甚至低於通用汽車(GM-US) 的8.2%。輝達(NVDA-US) 第三季預估營業利益率則高達66%。
相較之下，SpaceX更符合科技七巨頭的定位。SpaceX目前雖然尚未創造自由現金流，但該公司擁有透過衛星提供寬頻服務的星鏈（Starlink）這項重要的「現金牛」業務。
星鏈目前利用超過1.1萬顆衛星，在170多個國家提供服務，客戶數超過1,300萬人，第三季營業利益率達45%。
估值方面，SpaceX目前股價相當於未來12個月預估獲利的約40倍，僅略高於蘋果。根據FactSet數據，若以2027年曆年獲利計算，SpaceX的估值甚至低於蘋果。
《巴隆》認為，SpaceX同時具備AI布局、相對合理的估值，以及能夠創造現金流的核心業務，整體條件比特斯拉更符合科技七巨頭的定位。儘管這個投資組合並沒有正式的入列標準，但未來市場可能出現「科技八巨頭」（Great Eight）的新稱號。
不過，特斯拉可能也不會出現在新的名單中。這並非因為特斯拉的業務出了問題，而是因為特斯拉與SpaceX很可能合併。
市場分析師與投資人數月來持續揣測兩家公司合併的可能性。馬斯克10月也曾表示，兩家公司的董事會正在評估合併方案。
市場普遍預期，若交易成真，將由SpaceX擔任收購方，透過全股票交易支付一定溢價。依照不同交易日的股價計算，若以3股SpaceX股票交換1股特斯拉股票，特斯拉股東在合併公司完全稀釋後的持股比例將約為49%。
在此情境下， SpaceX與特斯拉合併後的公司，完全稀釋後估值將達約4兆美元，2027年預估本益比約65倍，其中約85%的獲利將來自SpaceX。
特斯拉與SpaceX的投資人最終是否會接受這個換股比例，或是其他比例，仍有待觀察。
至於合併案是否會遭到美國國會阻撓，德意志銀行分析師Edison Yu近期指出，他不認為國會會干預聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）及司法部的職權，這兩個行政機關才是負責審查企業合併案的主要單位。
Yu也提到，考慮到馬斯克曾為共和黨提供大量財務支持，外界可能認為民主黨取得國會優勢後，存在政治報復的可能性。不過，儘管國會有介入的方式，相關事務幾乎都由行政部門機關處理。
整體而言，特斯拉在科技七巨頭中的位置可能逐漸淡化，但若與SpaceX合併，反而可能成為規模更龐大的企業。正如《絕地7騎士》中的角色Chico，即使不再屬於原有團體，特斯拉仍將繼續存在，只是未來可能以更大型企業的一部分形式發展。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) may lose its spot among the U.S. stock market’s "Magnificent Seven" tech giants. Bloomberg analysis notes that Tesla lags the other six in cash flow, profitability and valuation, while Elon Musk’s space venture SpaceX (SPCX-US) fits the portfolio better.

The term "Magnificent Seven" was coined in 2023 by Bank of America strategist Michael Hartnett, borrowing from the classic western film to describe seven companies that can protect investors during market turbulence.

However, Tesla has always been different from the other members. Although it has built a sizable electric‑vehicle and energy‑storage business, its cash‑generation ability remains weak compared with the peers.
Tesla’s 2022 free cash flow hit a record roughly $8 billion, but Alphabet (GOOGL-US) generated $60 billion that year and Apple (AAPL-US) topped $100 billion.
Valuation is another issue. Tesla’s share price is about 180 times estimated earnings for the next 12 months, versus an average P/E of about 22 for the other Magnificent Seven firms.
In terms of profit margins, Tesla’s Q3 operating margin was only 2.6%, below General Motors (GM-US) at 8.2%, while Nvidia (NVDA-US) projected a Q3 margin of 66%.
By contrast, SpaceX aligns better with the Magnificent Seven profile. Although it has not yet produced free cash flow, its Starlink satellite broadband service is a major cash‑cow business.
Starlink now uses more than 11,000 satellites to serve over 170 countries, with more than 13 million customers and a Q3 operating margin of 45%.

Valuation-wise, SpaceX trades at roughly 40 times its estimated earnings for the next 12 months, only slightly above Apple. FactSet data show that using 2027 full‑year earnings, SpaceX’s valuation would be lower than Apple’s.

Bloomberg argues that SpaceX’s AI initiatives, relatively reasonable valuation and cash‑generating core business make it a better fit for the Magnificent Seven than Tesla. Although the group has no formal entry criteria, the market may soon talk about a "Great Eight".
Tesla may not even make the new list. This is not because its business is failing, but because Tesla and SpaceX are likely to merge.
Analysts and investors have been speculating for months about a possible merger. Musk said in October that the two boards are evaluating a deal.

The market generally expects that, if the deal goes through, SpaceX would be the acquirer, paying a premium with an all‑stock transaction. Depending on the share price on the deal date, a 3‑to‑1 swap (three SpaceX shares for one Tesla share) would leave former Tesla shareholders with about 49% of the combined company after full dilution.
In that scenario, the merged SpaceX‑Tesla entity would have a fully diluted valuation of roughly $4 trillion, a 2027 forward P/E of about 65×, with about 85% of earnings coming from SpaceX.
Whether Tesla and SpaceX investors will accept that swap ratio or a different one remains to be seen.

Regarding possible congressional opposition, Deutsche Bank analyst Edison Yu recently said he does not expect Congress to intervene in the FTC or Justice Department’s review, as those agencies handle merger scrutiny.

Yu added that, given Musk’s substantial donations to the Republican Party, some may fear Democratic‑controlled Congress could seek political retaliation. Nonetheless, any congressional involvement would be limited, with the executive agencies doing the heavy lifting.

Overall, Tesla’s position in the Magnificent Seven may fade, but a merger with SpaceX could create an even larger enterprise. Like the character Chico in "The Magnificent Seven," Tesla may no longer be part of the original group but will continue to exist as part of a bigger company.

items.title_en: NYFX: Trump Temporarily Halts Military Action Against Iran, Dollar Weakens as Euro, AUD, NZD Rise

歐元兌美元最新上漲0.64%，報1.1213美元。美元兌日元下跌0.41%，報157.89日元。
川普預定周一會晤卡達首相穆罕默德(Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani)，顯示各方正尋求衝突加速結束，外交斡旋持續升溫。
市場氣氛好轉也削弱美元的避險吸引力，布蘭特原油期貨則下跌近6%，收在每桶92.57美元。
Ebury首席經濟學家Enrique Diaz-Alvarez說：「目前美元空頭部位與交易的一大問題是市場持倉。積極參與交易與投機的市場參與者持有大量美元多頭部位，這意味著美元很難進一步上漲。我們預期歐元中期將反彈，因為市場可能低估了歐元區經濟復甦的力道。」
Diaz-Alvarez進一步說：「市場有些低估美國期中選舉對美國經濟的影響，AI投資一直是美國經濟表現的重要組成部分，而美國這次重大的政治變化，從邊際效應來看，將對這類投資產生負面影響。」
美股大盤周一上揚，以科技股為主的那斯達克指數領漲，扭轉上周經歷的一波猛烈賣壓。
由Shaun Osborne領軍的豐業銀行(Scotiabank)分析師團隊說：「市場焦點仍集中在美國科技股交易持續降溫，投資人也必須因應部分產業龍頭個股各自面臨的問題。」

paras_en: The U.S. dollar fell against major currencies on Monday (9th), with the euro and yen climbing, as President Trump said that unless diplomatic efforts continue, he is very unlikely to launch a new round of attacks on Iran, easing fears of a Middle East war and prompting investors to shift back into risk assets after last week's AI stock sell‑off.
The ICE Dollar Index (DXY), tracking the dollar against six major currencies, fell 0.47% to 101.75.
The euro rose 0.64% against the dollar to 1.1213. The dollar fell 0.41% against the yen to 157.89.
The pound rose 0.60% to 1.34290 against the dollar.

Trump is scheduled to meet Qatar’s Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al‑Thani on Monday, signalling that all sides are seeking a swift end to conflict and that diplomatic negotiations are heating up.
The improving market mood also weakened the dollar’s safe‑haven appeal, with Brent crude futures falling nearly 6% to $92.57 a barrel.

Ebury chief economist Enrique Diaz‑Alvarez said: “The big problem with the dollar short positions and trading is market holdings. Active traders and speculators hold large dollar long positions, which means the dollar is unlikely to rise further. We expect the euro to rebound in the medium term because the market may underestimate the strength of the euro‑area economic recovery.”

Diaz‑Alvarez added: “The market underestimates the impact of the U.S. midterm elections on the U.S. economy. AI investment has been an important component of U.S. economic performance, and this major political change will have a negative effect on such investment from a marginal perspective.”
U.S. stocks rose on Monday, led by the Nasdaq, which reversed last week’s sharp selling pressure.
Scotiabank analysts led by Shaun Osborne said: “The market focus remains on the cooling of U.S. tech stock trading, and investors must also respond to the issues facing individual industry leaders.”
U.S. inflation data is the focus. Investors will watch the U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI) released on Tuesday, with analysts estimating a 0.3% month‑over‑month increase for October.

According to CME Group’s FedWatch tool, rate futures show the market expects an 82% chance of a Fed rate hike at the December 8‑9 meeting, up from a week ago. The U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield rose 1.07 basis points to 4.87%.

The risk‑sensitive AUD and NZD rose together. The AUD rose 0.95% to 0.6922 against the dollar, and the NZD jumped 1.54% to 0.56301. Traders are also assessing the potential impact of New Zealand’s close weekend election results.

items.title: 川普：黃仁勳稱不知道她是間諜！FBI介入調查 輝達董事會啟動獨立調查
items.title_en: Trump: Jensen Huang Says He Didn’t Know She Was a Spy! FBI Investigates, NVIDIA Board Launches Independent Probe
paras: 美國總統川普周一(9日)表示，他已親自詢問輝達 (NVIDIA) (NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳，是否知道與他有密切關係的中國籍女性涉及間諜活動，黃仁勳回答「完全不知道她是間諜」。川普表示相信黃仁勳，並透露聯邦調查局(FBI)正在調查此事，認為黃仁勳最終應能安然度過風波。
川普在白宮簡報會上表示，他對相關指控感到驚訝，並稱自己已向黃仁勳直接詢問：「你知道她是間諜嗎？」黃仁勳回答「我完全不知道她是間諜」。川普表示：「我真的相信他」，並認為黃仁勳不必過度擔心FBI調查，預期他會沒事。
這番談話與川普前一天的說法有所不同。川普周日(8日)曾表示尚未與黃仁勳討論相關指控，並稱黃仁勳是「值得尊敬的人」，但周一則證實兩人已通話，黃仁勳也向他說明自己對該女子涉嫌間諜活動並不知情。
事件源自《紐約時報》10月的報導。報導引述美國情報官員說法指出，黃仁勳與一名中國籍商界女性Alice Huang關係密切，美方情報機構懷疑她曾替北京蒐集資訊。她曾任新加坡資料中心業者Megaspeed International高階主管，與黃仁勳同姓但沒有親屬關係。
黃仁勳周日已向輝達員工承認對妻子不忠，並為自己的婚外情公開道歉。他表示，自己的行為傷害妻子與子女，沒有任何藉口，並承諾對家人、員工及公司承擔責任。黃仁勳在聲明中並未點名該名女性，但表示將全力配合調查，致力保護輝達及美國國家安全。
輝達董事會周日宣布啟動獨立調查，將由獨立董事組成委員會，並聘請外部獨立法律顧問協助，釐清黃仁勳是否曾成為外國情報機構的目標，以及相關接觸是否涉及公司機密或國家安全問題。
輝達表示，目前董事會沒有理由相信美國國家安全或公司機密已遭到洩露，但仍將檢視所有可取得的資訊。董事會對黃仁勳及管理團隊仍有信心，黃仁勳也承諾全力配合調查，並繼續領導公司。
爭議焦點不僅在黃仁勳的私人關係，也牽涉Megaspeed與輝達的商業往來。美國官員曾調查Megaspeed，懷疑該公司可能協助中國取得受出口管制限制的先進AI晶片。美國自2022年起逐步收緊對中國出口先進晶片及相關製造設備的限制，使這起事件進一步涉及美中科技競爭與敏感技術流向。
《美聯社》報導指出，Megaspeed曾宣稱與輝達具有合作關係，其業務包括提供AI運算能力。美國官員關注的關鍵問題，是黃仁勳是否知悉相關情報活動，以及是否有機密或具戰略價值的資訊遭到轉交。這些疑慮仍有待調查證據釐清，不能僅憑私人關係認定公司機密已外洩。
中國外交部周一否認北京企圖透過該名女性接近黃仁勳，稱所謂「中國間諜」指控毫無根據，是抹黑中國的言論。新加坡政府此前也曾駁斥《華爾街日報》相關報導，表示新加坡政府及官員並未因Alice Huang與黃仁勳的關係或其涉嫌為中國情報來源而展開調查，也沒有對她進行相關調查。
美國國會方面，部分共和黨眾議員已於11月4日致函黃仁勳，要求他本月向國會說明相關報導，認為事件涉及中國取得美國敏感科技與資訊的重大國安疑慮。民主黨參議員Chris Coons也表示，將推動調查黃仁勳及輝達是否造成國家安全風險，並要求釐清科技企業領袖與川普政府之間的關係，以及相關政策決策過程。
這起風波也使川普與黃仁勳的密切關係受到更多檢視。兩人的互動至少可追溯至2025年，黃仁勳過去兩年多次公開支持川普政府政策，也頻繁前往華府遊說，希望美國放寬部分AI晶片對中國出口限制。
《路透社》指出，黃仁勳曾於2025年5月搭乘空軍一號陪同川普訪問中國，這是美國總統近10年來首次訪中；同年9月，他也出席中國國家主席習近平訪美期間在白宮舉行的國宴。媒體另報導，輝達承諾捐助2500萬美元，支持川普規劃中的白宮宴會廳工程。
川普政府過去也曾對輝達對中銷售政策作出調整。2025年4月，黃仁勳出席川普位於佛州海湖莊園的晚宴後，政府撤回部分限制輝達AI晶片出口中國的計畫；同年12月，川普宣布允許輝達向中國出口次高階AI晶片H200，並對相關銷售收取25%的費用。
此外，川普今年10月授予黃仁勳美國最高科學成就榮譽的同一天，也披露自己夏季曾買進最高160萬美元、賣出最高100萬美元的輝達股票。白宮當時表示，川普的投資組合由第三方金融機構獨立管理。
市場方面，輝達股價周一盤中一度跌至7個月低點，開盤前跌幅約5%，公司市值約4.5兆美元。此前在AI投資可持續性疑慮及科技股整體修正下，輝達股價今年以來累積漲幅已全數回吐，黃仁勳遭調查的消息又為股價增添新的不確定性。
Yorkville Ives & Co.合夥人Dan Ives指出，若董事會調查結果導致黃仁勳離任，將對輝達股價及公司全球策略造成重大風險。他認為，黃仁勳是輝達成長故事與營運策略的核心人物，事件也可能引發更多國會調查，並使公司對中國銷售晶片面臨更嚴格檢視。
eToro首席分析師Josh Gilbert則表示，黃仁勳參與了輝達崛起的各個關鍵環節，因此任何有關其領導地位的疑慮都會影響股東信心。不過，若調查最終沒有導致高層更替，事件對公司長期基本面的影響可能有限。
整體而言，這起事件已從企業領導人的私人關係，擴大為涉及外國情報活動、AI晶片出口管制及美中科技競爭的國安議題。輝達目前強調尚無證據顯示機密外洩，川普也公開表示相信黃仁勳，但董事會調查、FBI調查及國會後續問詢結果，將決定事件是否進一步衝擊黃仁勳的領導地位，以及輝達對中國市場的業務布局。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Monday (the 9th) that he personally asked NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang whether he knew a Chinese woman with close ties to him was involved in espionage, and Huang replied, "I had no idea she was a spy." Trump said he trusts Huang and disclosed that the FBI is investigating the matter, believing Huang will ultimately get through the storm unharmed.

At a White House briefing, Trump said he was surprised by the allegations and said he asked Huang directly, "Do you know she is a spy?" Huang answered, "I had no idea she was a spy." Trump added, "I really believe him," and said Huang need not worry excessively about the FBI probe, expecting he will be fine.

This conversation differs from Trump’s remarks the day before. On Sunday (the 8th) Trump said he had not yet discussed the allegations with Huang and called him "a respectable person," but on Monday he confirmed the two had spoken and Huang told him he was unaware of the woman’s alleged espionage activities.

The episode stems from a New York Times report in October that cited U.S. intelligence officials saying Huang had a close relationship with a Chinese businesswoman named Alice Huang, whom U.S. agencies suspect of gathering information for Beijing. She previously served as a senior executive at Singapore data‑center firm Megaspeed International; despite sharing a surname, she is not related to Jensen Huang.

On Sunday, Jensen Huang admitted to NVIDIA employees that he had been unfaithful to his wife and publicly apologized for his extramarital affair. He said his actions hurt his wife and children, offered no excuses, and pledged responsibility to his family, employees, and the company. While he did not name the woman, he said he would fully cooperate with investigations and work to protect NVIDIA and U.S. national security.

NVIDIA’s board announced on Sunday that it is launching an independent investigation, forming a committee of independent directors and hiring external legal counsel to determine whether Huang has been targeted by foreign intelligence and whether any contacts involved company secrets or national‑security issues.

NVIDIA said the board currently sees no reason to believe U.S. national security or corporate confidential information has been compromised, but it will review all available data. The board remains confident in Huang and the management team; Huang has pledged full cooperation and will continue to lead the company.

The controversy centers not only on Huang’s personal relationship but also on Megaspeed’s business dealings with NVIDIA. U.S. officials have investigated Megaspeed over suspicions that the firm may have helped China obtain advanced AI chips subject to export controls. Since 2022 the United States has gradually tightened restrictions on exporting advanced chips and related equipment to China, tying the case to the broader U.S.–China tech competition and sensitive technology flows.

According to the Associated Press, Megaspeed claimed to have a partnership with NVIDIA, offering AI computing capacity. U.S. officials are focused on whether Huang was aware of any intelligence activities and whether confidential or strategically valuable information was passed on. These concerns remain unresolved pending evidence and cannot be concluded solely on the basis of a personal relationship.

China’s foreign ministry on Monday denied that Beijing was trying to use the woman to approach Huang, calling the alleged "Chinese spy" claim baseless and a smear against China. Singapore’s government previously rebuffed a Wall Street Journal report, stating that neither the Singapore government nor its officials have launched any investigation into Alice Huang’s relationship with Huang or any alleged role as a Chinese intelligence source.

In Washington, some Republican members of Congress sent a letter to Huang on November 4 requesting that he explain the reports to Congress this month, arguing the matter raises serious national‑security concerns about China acquiring U.S. sensitive technology and information. Democratic Senator Chris Coons also said he will push for an inquiry into whether Huang and NVIDIA pose a national‑security risk and called for clarification of the ties between tech‑industry leaders and the Trump administration and the related policy‑making process.

The episode has put the close relationship between Trump and Huang under greater scrutiny. Their interactions date back at least to 2025, when Huang repeatedly voiced public support for Trump‑administration policies and frequently lobbied in Washington for relaxed AI‑chip export restrictions to China.

Reuters reported that Huang flew on Air Force One with Trump on a May 2025 visit to China, the first presidential trip to China in a decade, and that in September he attended a state dinner at the White House during Chinese President Xi Jinping’s visit. Media also reported that NVIDIA pledged $25 million to support a White House banquet hall project planned by Trump.

The Trump administration previously adjusted NVIDIA’s sales policy to China. In April 2025, after Huang attended a dinner at Trump’s Mar‑a‑Lago estate, the government rolled back parts of a plan to restrict NVIDIA’s AI‑chip exports to China; in December the same year, Trump announced permission for NVIDIA to ship its second‑tier AI chip, the H200, to China, imposing a 25% fee on related sales.

In addition, on the same day Trump awarded Huang the nation’s highest scientific honor in October, he disclosed that he had bought up to $1.6 million and sold up to $1 million of NVIDIA stock during the summer. The White House said Trump’s portfolio was managed independently by a third‑party financial firm.

On the market side, NVIDIA’s share price fell to a seven‑month low on Monday, dropping about 5% before the open and leaving the company with a market value of roughly $4.5 trillion. After earlier AI‑investment sustainability concerns and a broader tech‑stock correction, the stock’s year‑to‑date gains have been fully erased, and the investigation into Huang adds fresh uncertainty.

Yorkville Ives & Co. partner Dan Ives warned that if the board’s investigation leads to Huang’s departure, it would pose a major risk to NVIDIA’s share price and global strategy. He said Huang is central to NVIDIA’s growth story and operating strategy, and the episode could trigger further congressional probes and tighter scrutiny of the company’s chip sales to China.

eToro chief analyst Josh Gilbert noted that Huang has been involved in every key phase of NVIDIA’s rise, so any doubts about his leadership will affect shareholder confidence. However, if the probe ultimately does not result in a top‑executive change, the long‑term fundamental impact on the company may be limited.

Overall, the incident has grown from a private‑relationship issue involving a corporate leader into a national‑security matter encompassing foreign‑intelligence activity, AI‑chip export controls and U.S.–China tech rivalry. NVIDIA stresses there is no evidence of a leak, Trump publicly says he trusts Huang, and the outcomes of the board’s inquiry, the FBI investigation and congressional follow‑ups will determine whether the episode further threatens Huang’s leadership and NVIDIA’s business plans in China.

items.title: 輝達逆勢跌逾4% 成費半唯一殞落股 黃仁勳去留引爆華爾街論戰
items.title_en: Nvidia Falls Over 4% Against the Trend, the Only Decline in the S&P 500 Information Technology Index; Jensen Huang's Future Sparks Wall Street Debate
paras: 費半成分股中，輝達是唯一收跌的個股，週一 (9日) 下跌 4.27%，報 178.67 美元。輝達董事會宣布啟動獨立調查，釐清黃仁勳是否曾遭外國情報行動鎖定。董事會表示，目前沒有理由認為美國國安或公司機密已受損。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 董事會調查執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 是否曾遭外國情報行動鎖定，華爾街對他的去留出現分歧。有基金經理人認為，輝達內部缺乏明確接班人，可能促使部分機構投資人減碼。也有分析師研判，除非調查導致高層更替，否則短期衝擊主要反映在市場情緒。隨著 11 月 17 日財報公布在即，投資人也在觀察調查是否會拖慢輝達的投資決策，以及對中晶片出口會否面臨更嚴格的審查。
董事會是在媒體報導黃仁勳與一名中國女商人黃樂關係密切後啟動調查。美國情報機構認為，黃樂是中國國家安全部情報人員，曾向北京傳遞資訊。
輝達董事會正在釐清黃仁勳是否曾成為外國情報行動的目標，相關指控仍有待查證。
接班人選未明 華爾街對黃仁勳去留看法分歧
The Future Fund 基金經理人 Gary Black 質疑黃仁勳能否留任。他認為，董事會勢必檢視黃仁勳的行為與判斷力，而輝達內部缺乏一名公認的接班人，可能使部分投資組合經理人在未來幾週先行減碼，短期壓抑股價。
Pepperstone 研究主管 Chris Weston 則認為黃仁勳被撤換的機率低。
他指出，黃仁勳在這一波 AI 投資浪潮中扮演核心角色，若市場真認為他即將下台，輝達股價的反應會更劇烈。
紅杉資本合夥人 Shaun Maguire 雖批評黃仁勳的判斷，仍認為他對維持美國的 AI 領先地位難以取代。
特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 執行長馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 也留言表示同意。
PIMCO 前執行長 Mohamed El-Erian 指出，輝達對科技產業、金融市場與整體經濟都具有重要影響力，但投資人一向難以衡量企業對單一領導人的依賴，也難以替公司治理風險定價。如今事件又涉及國安與地緣政治，市場評估的變數隨之增加。
韓國供應鏈盯投資時程 花旗聚焦 H200 出口合規
韓國 NH 投資證券資深分析師 Ryu Young-ho 表示，美國政府似乎已知悉此事數月，因此預期立即衝擊有限。
對韓國供應商而言，更值得關注的是調查或內部審查若拖長，輝達會否延後投資決策。若影響進一步延伸至產品出貨或新品發布，波及範圍就可能擴大至整個半導體產業。
花旗分析師 Atif Malik 則把焦點放在監管機關是否加強審查 H200 晶片流入中國的管道，包括經由第三方中介的交易是否符合出口管制規定。
他估計，H200 對中銷售占輝達資料中心業務營收不到 1%。投資人仍須關注監管審查是否擴大，以及調查對輝達公司治理與長期領導穩定性的影響。
11 月 17 日財報成下一個觀察點
輝達預定於美東時間 11 月 17 日盤後 (台灣時間 11 月 18 日清晨) 公布 2027 會計年度第三季財報。
eToro 首席分析師吉 Josh Gilbert 表示，調查風波正值 AI 類股承壓之際，短期可能打擊投資情緒。輝達財報將是輝達面臨的下一場考驗，若調查最終導致高層更替，市場才會重新評估公司的長期前景。
美國總統川普 (Donald Trump) 表示，尚未就此事與黃仁勳通話，但肯定他的人品，希望事情平安落幕。
潘興廣場資本管理公司執行長艾克曼 (Bill Ackman) 則表示，若事件涉及國安，情況就會嚴重得多。他希望風波止於私人關係，並稱若有更深層的問題，黃仁勳仍應接受檢視。
paras_en: Among the S&P 500 Information Technology constituents, Nvidia was the only stock that closed lower on Monday (the 9th), dropping 4.27% to $178.67. Nvidia’s board announced it is launching an independent investigation to determine whether CEO Jensen Huang has ever been targeted by foreign intelligence operations. The board said there is currently no reason to believe U.S. national security or company secrets have been compromised.

Nvidia (NVDA-US) board’s probe into whether CEO Jensen Huang was ever the target of foreign intelligence activity has split Wall Street on his tenure. Some fund managers argue that Nvidia lacks a clear succession plan, which could prompt certain institutional investors to reduce exposure. Other analysts contend that unless the probe triggers a top‑management change, the short‑term impact will be mainly sentiment‑driven. With the fiscal Q3 earnings slated for November 17, investors are also watching whether the investigation will slow Nvidia’s investment decisions and whether chip exports to China could face tighter scrutiny.

The board opened the investigation after media reports linked Jensen Huang to a Chinese businesswoman, Huang Le, suggesting a close relationship. U.S. intelligence agencies allege that Huang Le is an operative of China’s Ministry of State Security and has passed information to Beijing.
Nvidia’s board is seeking to determine whether Jensen Huang was ever a target of foreign intelligence activity; the allegations remain unverified.
Unclear Succession Plan Fuels Wall Street Divide on Jensen Huang’s Future

Future Fund manager Gary Black questioned whether Jensen Huang can remain in his role. He believes the board will have to scrutinize Huang’s conduct and judgment, and that Nvidia’s lack of an acknowledged successor could lead some portfolio managers to trim positions over the next few weeks, putting short‑term pressure on the stock.
Pepperstone research head Chris Weston, on the other hand, thinks the odds of Huang being removed are low.
He noted that Huang has been a core figure in the current AI investment wave, and if the market truly believed he was about to step down, Nvidia’s share price reaction would be even more pronounced.
Sequoia Capital partner Shaun Maguire, while criticizing Huang’s judgment, still sees him as irreplaceable for maintaining U.S. leadership in AI.
Tesla (TSLA‑US) CEO Elon Musk also commented in agreement.

Former PIMCO chief Mohamed El‑Erian pointed out that Nvidia has a major impact on the tech sector, financial markets and the broader economy, but investors have historically struggled to gauge a company’s reliance on a single leader and to price governance risk. With national‑security and geopolitical dimensions now in play, the variables for market assessment have increased.
Korean Supply‑Chain Timing Under Scrutiny; Citi Focuses on H200 Export Compliance
Ryu Young‑ho, senior analyst at NH Investment & Securities in Korea, said the U.S. government appears to have been aware of the matter for months, so immediate impact is expected to be limited.

For Korean suppliers, the bigger question is whether a prolonged investigation or internal review will cause Nvidia to delay its investment decisions. If the delay extends to product shipments or new product launches, the ripple effect could spread across the entire semiconductor industry.
Citi analyst Atif Malik focused on whether regulators will tighten scrutiny of H200 chips flowing to China, including whether third‑party intermediary transactions comply with export‑control rules.

He estimated that H200 sales to China represent less than 1% of Nvidia’s data‑center revenue. Investors still need to watch for broader regulatory reviews and the impact of the probe on Nvidia’s corporate governance and long‑term leadership stability.
November 17 Earnings Are the Next Watchpoint
Nvidia is scheduled to release its fiscal 2027 third‑quarter results after market close on November 17 Eastern Time (early morning November 18 Taiwan time).

eToro chief analyst Josh Gilbert said the investigation comes as AI‑related stocks are under pressure and could dampen short‑term sentiment. Nvidia’s earnings will be the next test for the company, and only if the probe leads to a top‑management change will the market reassess its long‑term outlook.
Former U.S. President Donald Trump said he has not spoken with Jensen Huang about the matter yet, but he affirms Huang’s character and hopes the issue will be resolved peacefully.

Bill Ackman, CEO of Pershing Square Capital Management, warned that if the matter involves national security the stakes become much higher. He hopes the controversy stays limited to personal relationships and said that if deeper issues emerge, Huang should still be subject to scrutiny.

道瓊收在52,390點，上漲1,104點、漲幅2.15%；標普500指數收7,550點，上漲173點、漲幅2.35%；那斯達克指數收25,253點，上漲674點、漲幅2.74%。標普500創4月8日以來最大單日百分比漲幅，那指則創7月30日以來最大單日漲幅。
美國總統川普淡化再度攻擊伊朗的可能性，原油價格大幅下跌，減輕市場對物價壓力的擔憂。標普500十一大類股全數上漲，其中九類漲逾1%，工業與非必需消費類股均漲逾3%，表現居前。上週民主黨在期中選舉大勝，市場擔心新增監管衝擊AI投資熱潮，標普500因而創下2025年4月以來最大單週跌幅。
費城半導體指數上漲6.9%，扭轉上週跌逾12%的頹勢。博通(AVGO-US)上漲8.8%，超微(AMD-US)勁揚13.3%，是推動指數反彈的兩大助力。輝達則是費半唯一收黑成分股，收盤價降至4月7日以來最低；公司正調查黃仁勳是否成為外國情報活動的目標，投資人關注其領導職務前景。
財報方面，KKR(KKR-US)季度獲利創新高，股價上漲1.7%；星座能源(CEG-US)第三季調整後獲利優於預期，股價漲逾10%。整體市場上漲家數明顯多於下跌家數，紐約證交所約為4.06比1，那斯達克市場約為3.34比1。美國交易所成交量189.8億股，略高於過去20個交易日平均的187.2億股。
接下來市場將關注美國10月通膨數據，消費者物價指數（CPI）預定週二公布，生產者物價指數（PPI）則於週五發布。油價雖回落，先前強勁的就業報告仍使市場關注聯準會後續利率動向。里奇蒙聯準銀行總裁巴爾金週一表示，聯準會在規劃因應通膨的政策時，應審慎行事。

paras_en: On Monday, November 9, U.S. equities closed higher across the board as a sharp decline in oil prices eased inflation worries, prompting a rebound after last week's steep drop in AI stocks. The Dow Jones Industrial Average surged 1,104 points, while both the S&P 500 and Nasdaq gained more than 2%; semiconductor stocks led the recovery, though Nvidia (NVDA-US) fell 4.2% amid concerns over an investigation involving CEO Jensen Huang.

The Dow finished at 52,390 points, up 1,104 points (2.15%); the S&P 500 closed at 7,550 points, up 173 points (2.35%); and the Nasdaq ended at 25,253 points, up 674 points (2.74%). The S&P 500 posted its largest single‑day percentage gain since April 8, while the Nasdaq recorded its biggest one‑day rise since July 30.

U.S. President Donald Trump downplayed the likelihood of another attack on Iran, sending crude oil prices sharply lower and reducing market concerns about price pressures. All ten S&P 500 sector groups rose, with nine sectors gaining more than 1%; industrials and consumer discretionary both climbed over 3%, leading the gains. After Democrats’ sweeping victory in the midterm elections last week, the market feared new regulatory headwinds for AI investments, which had caused the S&P 500 to register its biggest weekly decline since April 2025.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 6.9%, reversing more than a 12% slide from the previous week. Broadcom (AVGO-US) rose 8.8% and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD-US) surged 13.3%, providing the two main lifts for the index’s rebound. Nvidia was the only component to close lower, with its price falling to the lowest level since April 7; the company is under investigation to determine whether Jensen Huang has become a target of foreign intelligence activities, prompting investor scrutiny of his leadership prospects.

On the earnings front, KKR (KKR-US) posted record quarterly profit, sending its shares up 1.7%; Constellation Energy (CEG-US) reported third‑quarter adjusted earnings that beat expectations, lifting its stock more than 10%. Overall, the number of advancing stocks far outpaced decliners, with a ratio of about 4.06 to 1 on the NYSE and roughly 3.34 to 1 on the Nasdaq. U.S. exchange trading volume reached 18.98 billion shares, slightly above the 20‑day average of 18.72 billion.

Going forward, the market will watch U.S. October inflation data, with the Consumer Price Index (CPI) scheduled for release on Tuesday and the Producer Price Index (PPI) due on Friday. Although oil prices have retreated, a previously strong jobs report keeps attention on the Federal Reserve’s next rate moves. Richmond Federal Reserve Bank President Thomas Barkin said on Monday that the Fed should act prudently when shaping policies to address inflation.

Diaz-Alvarez進一步說：「市場有些低估美國期中選舉對美國經濟的影響，AI投資一直是美國經濟表現的重要組成部分，而美國這次重大的政治變化，從邊際效應來看，將對這類投資產生負面影響。」
美股大盤周一上揚，以科技股為主的那斯達克指數領漲，扭轉上周經歷的一波猛烈賣壓。

items.title: AI「沉船」警鐘響起 美元跟著翻船？巴克萊拆解AI資本開支三道裂縫
items.title_en: AI "Sinking Ship" Alarm Rings: Does the Dollar Follow? Barclays Breaks Down AI Capital Expenditure into Three Cracks
paras: 最新外匯策略報告顯示，即便AI投資熱潮引發資本市場震盪，美元基本面支撐並未動搖。對此巴克萊表示，美國經濟數據維持強勁，AI資本開支週期短期內大幅下修機率不高，因此繼續看好美元回檔後逢低買進的交易策略。
目前，美元風險溢價已回落至約1%，創一年多以來最低。機構分析指出，受歐元空頭部位擁擠影響，歐元兌美元或階段性反彈至1.14附近，但依托美國宏觀經濟的持續韌性，這一輪上行情難以持續。
巴克萊引用1858年巨型遠洋郵輪「大東方號」建造往事作為類比：該計畫投資耗資巨大、一波三折，最終推動跨洋海底電報電纜落地，也衍生出匯市術語「cable」。
報告認為，當下AI投資浪潮是上世紀網路熱潮之後，規模宏大、前景未知的重大技術投資週期，市場正重新定價風險與報酬。
市場擔憂AI資本開支潛藏多重隱患：算力需求是否存在虛高、產業鏈交叉融資會否形成連鎖風險、資料中心建設面臨的地方政治阻力等。
但巴克萊判斷指出，存量資料中心建設項目將穩步落地，超大規模雲廠商並未放緩投資借貸計劃，預計2027年底進入正向現金流階段，算力擴容也帶動企業真實需求增長，AI技術浪潮已經成型，難以逆轉。
按幣種來看，歐元對沖美元的吸引力持續走弱。法國財政壓力疊加選舉帶來的政治不確定性，推升法國公債利差；歐洲央行終端利率預期回落至3%附近，進一步升息空間受限，歐元中期前景偏空，僅存技術性反彈機會。
日元則持續受益避險資金流入。測算顯示美股回檔幅度若擴大，美元兌日元可望向155區間靠攏，但投機部位轉為日元淨多頭，將會約束日元升值節奏。
亞洲貨幣走勢明顯分化：科技股波動拖累韓元，外資持續流出帶來上行壓力；印度盧比則因油價走低、本土AI部位有限支撐；馬來西亞林吉特則同時承受油價下跌與資料中心投資預期降溫的雙重壓力。
巴克萊總結指出，目前AI股票拋售尚未對美元形成實質衝擊，美國經濟增速高於潛在水準、通膨黏性猶存，資本開支週期短期不會出現斷崖式收縮，美元依舊具備配置價值。
paras_en: The latest foreign exchange strategy report shows that even though the AI investment boom has shaken capital markets, the fundamentals supporting the dollar remain unchanged. Barclays notes that U.S. economic data stay strong and the probability of a sharp short‑term cut in AI capital spending is low, so it continues to favor a strategy of buying the dollar on pullbacks after a rally.

Currently, the dollar risk premium has fallen to about 1%, its lowest level in over a year. The firm’s analysis points out that a crowded short position in the euro has pushed the euro‑to‑dollar rate to rebound around 1.14, but the ongoing resilience of the U.S. macroeconomy makes this upward move unlikely to sustain.

Barclays uses the 1858 construction of the massive ocean liner "Great Eastern" as an analogy: the project was hugely costly and fraught with setbacks, ultimately enabling the deployment of trans‑Atlantic telegraph cables and giving rise to the currency‑market term "cable."

The report argues that the current AI investment wave is the largest, most uncertain major technology investment cycle since the internet boom of the last century, and that markets are re‑pricing risk and reward.

Market concerns about AI capital spending include whether computing power demand is overestimated, whether cross‑industry financing could create chain risks, and the political resistance faced by data‑center construction.

However, Barclays believes that existing data‑center projects will steadily materialise, large cloud providers are not slowing their investment‑and‑borrowing plans, and by the end of 2027 they will enter a positive cash‑flow phase. Computing capacity expansion will also drive real corporate demand, and the AI technology wave is already taking shape and unlikely to reverse.

In terms of currencies, the euro’s appeal as a hedge against the dollar continues to weaken. French fiscal pressure combined with election‑related political uncertainty pushes French bond spreads higher; expectations that the European Central Bank’s terminal rate will fall to around 3% further limit room for rate hikes, making the euro’s medium‑term outlook bearish with only a technical rebound possibility.

The yen continues to benefit from safe‑haven flows. Calculations suggest that if the U.S. equity pullback widens, the dollar‑to‑yen rate could converge toward the 155 area, but speculative positions turning net long on the yen will constrain its appreciation pace.

Asian currencies show clear divergence: volatility in tech stocks drags the Korean won, continued outflows of foreign capital exert upward pressure; the Indian rupee suffers from falling oil prices and limited domestic AI support; the Malaysian ringgit faces dual pressure from lower oil prices and a cooling expectation of data‑center investment.

Barclays concludes that the current sell‑off in AI stocks has not materially impacted the dollar. U.S. growth remains above potential, inflationary stickiness persists, and the capital‑spending cycle is unlikely to experience a cliff‑like contraction in the short term, leaving the dollar still attractive for allocation.

items.title_en: U.S. Political Shakeup! Dollar Movement Adds Variables, Forex Investors Focus on Three Key Signals
paras: 美國期中選舉結果揭曉，民主黨一舉奪下參、眾兩院多數席次。這不僅使美國總統川普未來兩年的政策推動面臨國會制衡，也瞬間掀起全球金融市場的波瀾。美元指數應聲下跌，觸及近一個月低點，歐元、日圓等主要貨幣全面走強。隨著政治版圖重洗牌，市場焦點迅速從選舉結果轉向政策走向、聯準會利率及經濟前景，美元後市如何發展，正牽動全球投資人的神經。
期中選舉改變政治版圖　美元走勢面臨新考驗
2026年美國期中選舉於11月3日落幕，民主黨不僅奪回眾議院控制權，也在參議院取得多數席次，打破共和黨原先掌握的國會優勢。隨著新一屆國會預計於2027年1月3日上任，美國將形成民主黨掌控國會、共和黨掌握白宮的分立政府局面。市場開始評估，美國總統川普未來推動財政、貿易及產業政策，可能面臨更大的國會制衡，進而影響美國經濟與金融市場走向。

根據路透社11月4日報導，民主黨在期中選舉取得重大勝利後，美元指數盤中下跌0.6%，一度觸及101.27的近一個月低點；歐元兌美元上漲0.6%，升至1.1258美元，日圓也升值近0.8%，來到1美元兌157.92日圓，瑞士法郎同步走強。與此同時，美國10年期公債殖利率下滑近5個基點至4.915%。市場預期，在國會制衡下，川普政府的財政刺激力道可能縮減，AI相關支出也可能放緩，進而下修對2027年升息的預期。
由於美國近年經濟成長受到AI相關投資支撐，民主黨取得國會多數後，市場也關注未來針對科技企業及AI產業的監管方向。不過，在分立政府格局下，大規模新法案較難通過，相關監管短期內出現重大轉變的可能性有限。後續市場仍將觀察AI投資動能能否延續，以及對美國經濟成長的支撐力道。
此外，國會版圖改變也不代表川普政府的政策將全面轉向。美國總統仍握有法案否決權，部分行政權限及貿易政策也不完全受國會立法進度限制。因此，選舉結果雖然為美元帶來短期壓力，但後續走勢仍取決於經濟基本面、貨幣政策及國際市場變化。
美元後市怎麼走？掌握三大關鍵觀察指標
事實上，美元走勢受到多重因素影響。除了美國政治局勢，聯準會（Fed）貨幣政策、美國經濟數據及國際資金流向，同樣扮演重要角色。首先是美國政府政策方向：隨著國會權力結構改變，川普政府未來在財政、稅收及經貿政策上的推動空間可能受到限制。若府會政策協商陷入僵局，政策短期內較難出現重大轉變，反而可能降低市場面臨的政策不確定性。
其次是聯準會貨幣政策：美元與美國利率走勢向來緊密相關。若市場預期利率維持高檔，有助支撐美元資產吸引力；反之，若經濟成長放緩、降息預期升溫，美元則可能面臨壓力。因此，未來的通膨與就業數據依然是關鍵指標。
第三則是地緣政治與避險資金流向：美元作為全球主要交易與儲備貨幣，當國際衝突升溫、能源價格大幅波動或風險偏好下降時，資金仍會重新流向具備避險特性的美元資產，為美元帶來支撐。
換言之，期中選舉雖然改變美國政治版圖，並在短期內牽動美元走勢，但分立政府也意味著政策大幅轉向的可能性降低。未來匯率走勢仍取決於多項因素交互影響，市場除了關注川普政府與國會的互動，也須持續追蹤美債殖利率、聯準會利率決策，以及歐元區、日本等主要經濟體的貨幣政策變化，才能更全面掌握全球匯市動向。

paras_en: The U.S. midterm election results were announced, with the Democratic Party sweeping majorities in both the House and Senate. This not only places President Trump’s policy agenda for the next two years under congressional checks, but also instantly stirs global financial markets. The dollar index fell, hitting a near one‑month low, while the euro, yen, and other major currencies strengthened. As the political map is reshuffled, market focus quickly shifts from election outcomes to policy direction, Fed rates, and economic outlook, with the dollar’s future trajectory gripping global investors’ nerves.
Midterm election reshapes the political map, presenting new tests for the dollar’s movement.

The 2026 U.S. midterm election concluded on November 3, with the Democratic Party not only regaining control of the House but also securing a majority in the Senate, breaking the Republican Party’s prior congressional advantage. With the new Congress expected to convene on January 3, 2027, the U.S. will have a divided government: Democrats controlling Congress and Republicans holding the White House. Markets are evaluating how President Trump’s fiscal, trade, and industrial policies may face greater congressional checks, potentially influencing the U.S. economy and financial markets.

According to Reuters on November 4, after the Democrats’ decisive midterm victory, the dollar index fell 0.6% intraday, briefly touching a near one‑month low of 101.27; the euro rose 0.6% against the dollar to 1.1258, the yen also appreciated nearly 0.8% to 157.92 yen per dollar, and the Swiss franc strengthened. Meanwhile, the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield fell almost 5 basis points to 4.915%. Markets expect that under congressional checks, the Trump administration’s fiscal stimulus may be reduced, AI‑related spending may slow, and expectations for a 2027 rate hike may be cut.

Because recent U.S. economic growth has been supported by AI‑related investment, the Democratic majority in Congress has prompted market attention to future regulatory directions for tech companies and the AI industry. However, under a divided government, large new legislation is harder to pass, limiting the likelihood of major regulatory shifts in the short term. Markets will continue to watch whether AI investment momentum persists and its support for U.S. economic growth.

Moreover, the congressional shift does not mean the Trump administration’s policies will fully reverse. The president still holds veto power, and some executive authority and trade policy are not entirely constrained by congressional legislative progress. Thus, while the election results exert short‑term pressure on the dollar, its subsequent trajectory still depends on economic fundamentals, monetary policy, and international market changes.
How will the dollar move in the future? Three key indicators to watch.

In fact, the dollar’s movement is influenced by multiple factors. Beyond U.S. political conditions, Fed monetary policy, U.S. economic data, and international capital flows also play important roles. First is U.S. government policy direction: with the congressional power structure changed, the Trump administration’s space to push fiscal, tax, and trade policy may be limited. If policy negotiations stall, significant changes are unlikely in the short term, potentially reducing market policy uncertainty.

Second is Fed monetary policy: the dollar and U.S. interest rates have always been closely linked. If markets expect rates to stay high, it helps support the dollar’s asset appeal; conversely, if economic growth slows and rate‑cut expectations rise, the dollar may face pressure. Therefore, future inflation and employment data remain key indicators.

Third is geopolitical and safe‑haven capital flows: as the world’s main trading and reserve currency, the dollar attracts funds when international conflicts flare, energy prices swing sharply, or risk appetite declines, providing support for the dollar.

In other words, while the midterm election changes the U.S. political map and temporarily affects the dollar, a divided government also means a lower likelihood of drastic policy shifts. Future exchange rates still depend on the interaction of multiple factors; markets must monitor the Trump administration’s interaction with Congress, U.S. Treasury yields, Fed decisions, and monetary policy changes in major economies like the eurozone and Japan to fully grasp global currency market trends.

The Democratic Party's overwhelming victory in the congressional elections has raised market concerns that artificial intelligence (AI) could face stricter regulation, especially regarding data‑center construction, severely hurting US equities. The tech‑heavy Nasdaq posted its largest single‑day decline since April 2025, and on Friday Asian markets led by tech stocks saw the Japanese Nikkei plunge 7% at the open, Taiwan’s market tumble to a six‑month low, and South Korea’s index drop nearly 9% triggering circuit‑breaker rules. The stock‑market sell‑off spurred yen‑related safe‑haven buying. Meanwhile, Japan’s government reported a 2.2% year‑on‑year rise in September real wages, the ninth consecutive month of growth, giving the Bank of Japan (BOJ) grounds to keep raising rates. Former BOJ chief economist Kameda said in a Reuters interview that the BOJ is expected to hike rates in December and continue tightening next year until the policy rate reaches 2% to counter mounting inflation pressure, supporting the yen and pushing the USD/JPY low to 157.21.

According to US official data, October non‑farm payrolls added 165,000 jobs, and the combined August‑September employment gains were 84,000 higher than previously reported. The unemployment rate fell to 4.1%, beating expectations and bolstering the case for a Federal Reserve rate hike in December. Michigan’s November consumer‑confidence index rose to 51.0, and New York Fed President Williams said the US economy shows surprising resilience despite still‑high inflation, while San Francisco Fed President Daly called for further tightening, lifting the dollar to a high of 158.56 against the yen. The dollar‑yen resistance is projected at 158.70‑158.90 with support at 157.90‑158.10.
EUR/USD

Investor worries over tighter regulatory scrutiny and a slowdown in AI deployment have battered Asian tech‑heavy markets, pulling risk‑sensitive currencies such as the Australian and New Zealand dollars lower. Euro‑area retail sales fell 0.7% month‑on‑month in September and were only up 0.4% year‑on‑year, both missing forecasts. German industrial production growth slowed sharply to an annual 0.55% in September, and France’s current‑account deficit widened to €2.7 billion, pushing the euro down from its recent high of 1.1234 against the dollar.

ECB chief economist Lane later said the ECB must contain the spill‑over effects of high energy prices on broader inflation and aim to bring inflation back to its 2% target within the next one to two years. However, strong US employment data is supporting the dollar, leaving the euro trading around the low of 1.1130. The euro‑dollar resistance is estimated at 1.1160‑1.1180 with support at 1.1095‑1.1115.
GBP/USD

Concerns over AI regulation have dented risk appetite, and Lloyds reported that UK house‑price growth in October unexpectedly fell 0.6% month‑on‑month and 1.2% year‑on‑year, worse than market expectations, putting pressure on the pound which slipped from a high of 1.3463 against the dollar. Subsequently, Bank of England chief economist Peel said uncertainty remains over whether a second‑round inflation effect will materialise, leaving the path of rates next year undefined, which pushed the pound down to a low of 1.3339 against the dollar. The pound‑dollar resistance is projected at 1.3370‑1.3390 with support at 1.3300‑1.3320.
